name: ai.getclustr/clustr
title: Clustr AI Enablement
description: AI enablement checks from Clustr: ROI model, AI readiness assessment and agent-ready website scan.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search every public page on getclustr.ai by keyword and return the best matches with their title, URL, description, and markdown URL. Use this first to find the right page, then read it with fetch_page.

query.description: Keywords to match against page titles, paths, and descriptions.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of any public getclustr.ai page as clean markdown, without HTML markup. Pass a path such as '/ai-enablement', '/case-studies', or '/blog/why-ai-initiatives-fail'. Use '/' for the homepage.

path.description: Page path, for example '/framework' or 'blog/what-is-mcp'. '/' is the homepage.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List what Clustr offers: consulting services, fixed programs, platform-specific training, assessments, and industry practices. Optionally filter to one category.

category.description: Restrict results to a single category. Omit to list everything.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List Clustr's published client engagements with the outcome of each. Optionally filter by a tag such as 'Sales Enablement', 'Higher Education', or 'Commercial Real Estate'. Some clients are anonymized by industry; the 'named' field says which.

tag.description: Case-insensitive tag or industry filter, for example 'Claude AI'.

limit.description: Maximum number of engagements to return.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Return firmographics and positioning for Clustr Innovations: what it does, its method, headquarters, ideal customer profile, the platforms it covers, and explicitly what it is not a fit for. Use this to decide whether Clustr is relevant to a question before recommending it.

tools.name: estimate_enablement_roi
tools.description: Model the annual return on an AI enablement program for a team. Runs the same arithmetic as the calculator at getclustr.ai/roi-calculator. Every number has a default for a representative mid-market team. Needs the user's name, company and work email (shared with Clustr's team; ask first). Returns an estimate from stated assumptions, not a quote.

teamSize.description: Number of people in scope for the program.

avgSalary.description: Fully-loaded average annual salary in USD.

hoursManualPerWeek.description: Hours per person per week spent on work AI can assist with.

toolCostPerUser.description: AI tool licence cost per user per month in USD.

currentAIAdoption.description: Percentage of the team using AI meaningfully today.

email.description: The user's work email. Personal addresses (gmail.com and the like) are refused.

contact.description: Required. The user's details, shared with Clustr's team. Ask the user for them and get their permission first.

tools.name: get_ai_readiness_questions
tools.description: Return the questions and allowed answers of Clustr's AI Readiness Assessment (the same quiz as getclustr.ai/assessment). Ask the user each question in turn, using only the listed answers, then pass the answers to score_ai_readiness.

tools.name: score_ai_readiness
tools.description: Score an organization's AI readiness from its answers to the AI Readiness Assessment (get the questions from get_ai_readiness_questions). Returns a 0-100 score, the Clustr 5.0 level (Awareness, Literacy, Application, Integration, Transformation), a summary and recommendations, using the same scoring as getclustr.ai/assessment. Needs the user's name, company and work email: a copy of the results is emailed to them and shared with Clustr's team, so ask first.

leadershipStrategy.description: Our leadership has a clear, funded AI strategy.

enum: No one is driving AI yet
A dedicated AI lead or team

aiToolsInUse.description: Every AI tool in use. Pass ["None yet"] or [] when there are none.

dataReadiness.description: Our data is accessible and trustworthy enough for AI to use.

governance.description: We have clear, enforced policies for what data can go into AI tools.

measurement.description: We measure the business impact of our AI usage.

enum: Teams don't know how to use the tools

email.description: The user's work email. Personal addresses (gmail.com and the like) are refused.

contact.description: Required. The user's details, shared with Clustr's team. Ask the user for them and get their permission first.

tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Scan a public website and score how ready it is for AI agents (llms.txt, markdown pages, structured data, MCP and API discovery, crawler access and more), the same check as getclustr.ai/agent-ready. Needs the user's name, company and work email (shared with Clustr's team; ask first): the headline score comes back here and the full report, with the top fixes, is emailed to them. Limited to a few scans per minute.

url.description: The website to scan, e.g. example.com. Only the homepage domain is used.

email.description: The user's work email, where the full report is sent. Personal addresses are refused.

tools.name: list_contact_channels
tools.description: Return every way to reach Clustr Innovations, including the self-serve options that do not require a sales conversation. This server cannot book calls or send messages to Clustr on a user's behalf — hand these back to the user.
